title: Motorsport Telemetry (MTJ / MTX)
description:
Writer-strict schema for every JSON object in an MTJ recording or MTX sidecar.

A file is JSONL (one JSON value per LF line), not one JSON document. Validate each line:
  MTJ (.telemetry.jsonl) — line 1 $defs.mtj_header, line 2 $defs.laps, then $defs.channel | $defs.span
  MTX (.telemetry.ext.jsonl) — one or more groups of $defs.mtx_header then $defs.channel | $defs.span

String lengths are Unicode code points (JSON Schema maxLength). Omit a key instead of writing "". Compact JSON, no insignificant whitespace, no BOM, trailing LF.

Limits:
  name (channel n, span n, MTX group n)     1–64     Speed, Ride Height FL, 443-1, Sebring 12H 2025
  identity (drv veh ven evt ses)            1–80     Tobi, Sebring
  unit u                                    1–24     km/h, °C, mm, bpm, %
  fmt                                       1–16     0.0°C, 000, 000%, 0°   (no whitespace)
  tz                                        3–64     America/New_York, UTC
  label text                                1–80     brake lock, bottomed
  chrome r[].t                              1–120    LMP2 stints during the race
  chrome pill r[].p[]                       1–32     Avg lap, 1:52.1
  span p.title                              1–32     #443
  span p.sub                                1–48     EL · 1:52.1
  span m name / value                       1–32 / 1–48
  date / time                               1–32     decorative vendor text
  clk                                       1–32     gps, utc, time_of_day
  hint                                      1–64     FP1
  hash                                      16       0123456789abcdef
  color c                                   7        #e11d48
  r items ≤ 8, m items ≤ 16, lbl items ≤ 256

Lattice, uniqueness, join (host = ext + ext.utc − host.utc), and MTX vis are enforced by crates/telemetry-format/scripts/validate-mtx.py, not by JSON Schema. Readers ignore unknown keys; format objects set additionalProperties=false; MTJ meta deliberately permits arbitrary keys and JSON values.

vis.title: Visibility
vis.description: 0 hidden, 1 shown. Writers emit the integers 0 and 1, never true/false. MTX: required on every header and record (1 = shown when the group is open). MTJ: omit to default 1.

ns.title: Nanoseconds
ns.description: Integer nanoseconds. File-relative on t0, s, e, dur, lbl times, and lap bounds. Never a string, never a float, never ISO-8601. 10_000_000 = 10 ms, 1_000_000_000 = 1 s.

utcEpochNs.title: Unix-epoch nanoseconds at t=0
utcEpochNs.description: Required join key. Unix-epoch nanoseconds (UTC) at this file or group's t=0. utc_epoch_ns = file_relative_ns + utc. Join: host_file_ns = ext_file_ns + ext.utc − host.utc. Copy the host utc when sidecar times are already host-relative.

name.title: Channel, span, or group name
name.description: Case-sensitive. Unique among channels in the file. 1–64 Unicode code points. Prefer the source spelling (Speed, Ride Height FL) or a short stint id (443-1). Not a sentence — put prose in r[].t or span m.

identity.title: Recording identity string
identity.description: MTJ header only (drv veh ven evt ses). 1–80. Omit when unknown. Not present on MTX.

unit.title: Declared unit
unit.description:
Source unit string, 1–24. Prefer the canonical name. Aliases (kph, mp/h, °C, PSI) resolve through the shared registry. Two units convert iff they share a dimension that is not count or marker. value_si = value * factor + offset (offset only on C/F).

Convertible canonical names:
  length  m mm cm km in ft mile
  speed   m/s km/h mph kn          (km/h↔mph; mp/h and mi/h = mph; kph/kmh/kmph/km/hr = km/h)
  accel   m/s^2 g
  angle   rad deg rev              (° = deg)
  angvel  rad/s rpm deg/s
  angacc  rad/s^2 deg/s^2
  press   Pa kPa MPa bar mbar psi atm inHg
  temp    K C F                    (°C = C, °F = F)
  time    s ms timespan_ms us ns min h
  freq    Hz kHz
  force   N kN lbf
  torque  Nm lbft
  energy  J kJ MJ kWh
  power   W kW hp PS
  elec    V mV A mA ohm
  mass    kg g_mass lb
  volume  m^3 L mL gal
  vflow   m^3/s L/s L/h
  mflow   kg/s kg/h
  ratio   ratio % %/s %/Period
  log     dBm dB

Not convertible (labels): count laps gear code; marker raw flag state pp1 Driver defined text.

timespan_ms is integer milliseconds 0..=360000000 (100 h), rendered M:SS.FFF. Same SI scale as ms; the name is the race-time format. Do not invent a unit from the channel name.

fmt.title: Format hint
fmt.description: How to print a sample. 1–16 characters, NO whitespace. Glue the number mask to the unit: 0.0°C not "0.0 °C". 000 zero-pads an integer. 000% is saturation. 0° is a heading. timespan_ms renders integer milliseconds as M:SS.FFF (H:MM:SS.FFF from 1 h). Viewers MAY ignore fmt.

timespanMs.title: timespan_ms storage
timespanMs.description: Integer milliseconds. 0..=360000000 (100 hours). u32 on disk. Math (avg, delta, sum) is on this integer. Render with M:SS.FFF under one hour (1:50.332) and H:MM:SS.FFF from one hour (1:30:00.000). Never a float. Never a civil clock.

timespanValue.title: Typed timespan_ms meta value
timespanValue.description: Writer-strict hover value for race times. v is integer ms. u is timespan_ms (laptime_ms / racetime_ms aliases). Display is M:SS.FFF. Average several Best fields with mean(v), then format.

unitCatalog.title: Conversion registry (documentation)
unitCatalog.description: Every unit the Rust registry can convert. factor is value_si = value * si + off. off omitted when 0. aka are accepted spellings. Not a JSONL line shape.

ianaTimezone.title: IANA timezone
ianaTimezone.description: Display only — never a join key. 3–64. Area/Location (America/New_York) or UTC. Not EDT, not EST, not -04:00, not a civil datetime.

hexColor.title: Span color
hexColor.description: Exactly # plus six hex digits. Required #. Not rgb(), not a name, not #RGB shorthand.

hash.title: Schema hash
hash.description: Exactly 16 lowercase hex digits. MTX: hash of the host this sidecar was built for. MTJ: this recording's schema hash.

labelText.title: Trace comment
labelText.description: 1–80. Short note drawn as a dot on a trace; hover expands a full-height dotted vertical. Not a sample. Illegal on gauge/compass.

chromeLine.title: Group chrome text
chromeLine.description: 1–120. A sentence on the right of an MTX group header. Use for descriptions. Use a pill for facts.

pillPart.title: Chrome pill label or value
pillPart.description: 1–32. First string is the label, second is the value. Both short: ["Avg lap","1:52.1"].

spanTitle.title: On-bar span title
spanTitle.description: 1–32. Drawn on the span. Car number or short name. Hover facts go in m, not here.

spanSub.title: On-bar span subtitle
spanSub.description: 1–48. Drawn on the span under the title. Driver initials and a lap time, not a paragraph.

metaName.title: Span hover field name
metaName.description: 1–32. Left side of a hover pair. Title case noun: Laps, Best, Avg, License.

metaValue.title: Span hover field value
metaValue.description: 1–48. Always a string, even when it looks numeric: "28", "1:50.332". Not a JSON number.

dateString.title: Decorative date
dateString.description: 1–32. Vendor date text, unchanged. Not the clock. Do not join with this.

timeString.title: Decorative time of day
timeString.description: 1–32. Vendor time text, unchanged. Not utc, not a join key.

clockName.title: Vendor clock name
clockName.description: 1–32. gps, utc, or time_of_day. Leftover vendor-scale metadata. Not a timezone and not a join key.

src.title: Source format
src.description: Where the recording came from. jsonl means this document was authored as JSONL, not converted.

plt.title: Plot class
plt.description:
How to draw the channel. Omit for a normal Y-vs-time overlay (trace). Write the full word, not t/g/c.
  trace   — Speed, throttle, brake, steering, RPM, ride height. May share an axis with the same unit. Labels (lbl) are legal only here.
  gauge   — Temperature, BPM, SpO2, and other foreign scalars. Own pane. Do not overlay on Speed.
  compass — Wind direction, heading. Domain wraps 0–360°. Do not plot as an unbounded Y axis.

label.title: Trace label pair
label.description: [file-relative ns, text]. ns is a lattice point. Pairs strictly increasing in time. Drawn as a dot on this channel; hover = dotted vertical across the full trace view.

scale.title: Display scale
scale.description:
[min, max] suggested window. Not a clip and not a unit conversion. Either bound may be null. Omit the key if you do not know an honest range. min must be < max when both are numbers.
  temp     [60, 120] or [0, 150]
  BPM      [40, 200]
  SpO2     [80, 100]
  heading  [0, 360]

chromeText.title: Chrome text item
chromeText.description: One sentence on the right of the MTX group header. {"t":"…"}.
chromeText.$comment: JSONL mtx header r element {t}. No binary sidecar header; MTX is JSONL-only.

chromePill.title: Chrome pill item
chromePill.description: A fact on the right of the MTX group header. {"p":[label, value]}.

spanPrimary.title: On-bar span chrome
spanPrimary.description: Drawn on the span bar. title = car number / name. sub = driver · lap. Hover facts belong in m.

metaPair.title: Span hover pair
metaPair.description: ["Name", value] — hover only. Name is a string. Value is text, a timespan_ms integer, or {"v":ms,"u":"timespan_ms"}. Race times MUST use timespan_ms so they can be averaged. Order is hover order. Do not put the title here.

lap.title: Lap tuple
lap.description: [number, start_ns, end_ns, complete, first_video_frame_or_null, stint, stint_lap, kind, start_boundary, end_boundary]. Trailing fields are optional for older documents. end > start; boundaries lie on the time lattice.

fileMetadata.title: File-level descriptive metadata
fileMetadata.description: Additional file-level metadata, including resolved TRACK.yml context. Omit meta when empty. Preserve unknown keys and arbitrary nested JSON values, including null. Recognized fields override effective descriptive identity only; native identity, clocks, timezone placement, samples, video timing, and session keys remain unchanged.
fileMetadata.$comment: MTJ header meta only; MTX export does not persist file-level metadata. This object deliberately permits arbitrary properties.

mtj_header.title: MTJ recording header (line 1)
mtj_header.description: First line of a .telemetry.jsonl recording. mtj, q, dur required. Write utc and tz whenever known so the file can be placed on the absolute axis. Omit empty optional keys and omit o when it is 0.

mtj.description: Recording document version. Independent of mtx.

q.description: Lattice quantum in nanoseconds. Every t0, sample instant, lap bound, span bound, label ns, and dur is o + k·q. Typical: 10000000 (10 ms) when the slowest channel is 100 Hz.

dur.description: Exclusive file-relative end. A lattice point ≥ o. Last legal instant is just before dur.

abs.description: Vendor clock reading at t=0. Not a join key. Do not use this instead of utc.

abe.description: Vendor clock reading at dur. Not a join key.

vpts.description: Presentation timestamp of every video frame, ns, presentation order, non-decreasing. Preserves the source video timeline exactly.
vpts.$comment: Non-decreasing order and vpts-requires-vf are enforced by the reader, not JSON Schema (dependentRequired covers presence).

mtx_header.title: MTX group header
mtx_header.description: Starts a sidecar folder. Records that follow belong to this group until the next mtx header or EOF. There is no k:"f" folder record. Required: mtx n q dur vis utc tz. Copy host utc and tz when times are host-relative so the join shift is zero.
mtx_header.$comment: JSONL-only. A later mtx header is a new folder, not a second file.

mtx.description: Extension document version. Independent of mtj.

n.description: Folder title shown in the UI. The sidecar group is this name.

q.description: This group's lattice quantum, nanoseconds. Need not equal the host q.

dur.description: Exclusive end of this group's own timeline. Independent of the host dur.

r.description: Right-aligned chrome, left-to-right. Mix {"t":"sentence"} and {"p":["label","value"]}. Max 8 items.

abs.description: Vendor-clock reading. Not a join key.

abe.description: Vendor-clock end. Not a join key.

channel.title: Sample channel
channel.description:
One sampled signal. Required: n hz v. MTX also requires vis. t[i] = t0 + i·period_ns(hz). null in v is a missing value at that instant, not a hole in time.

Foreign signals (do not overlay on Speed):
  Water Temp   plt=gauge   sc=[60,120]  rnd=1  fmt=0.0°C
  Heart Rate   plt=gauge   sc=[40,200]  rnd=0  fmt=000
  SpO2         plt=gauge   sc=[80,100]  rnd=0  fmt=000%
  Wind Dir     plt=compass sc=[0,360]   rnd=0  fmt=0°

lbl is legal only when plt is omitted or trace.

k.description: Omit or c. Never s (that is a span).

n.description: Channel name. Unique in the file. Case-sensitive.

hz.description: Sample rate in hertz. Prefer a JSON integer when it divides 1e9 (100, 50, 25, 10, 1). period_ns must be a multiple of header q.

v.description: Engineering values, oldest first. At least one element. null = missing at that lattice instant. Integers as JSON integers (12 not 12.0).

t0.description: First-sample file-relative ns. Default o. Lattice point. A sidecar covering only lap 3 uses that lap's start_ns, not 0.

rnd.description: Decimal places to show, 0–15. 0 with fmt=000 prints an integer BPM. 1 with fmt=0.0°C prints one decimal.

lbl.description: Trace-only comments. Forbidden when plt is gauge or compass. Max 256 pairs, strictly increasing ns.

span.title: Span interval
span.description: An interval [s,e) on the file-relative timeline — a stint, a yellow, a pit — not a sampled signal. k must be s. e > s. Both lattice points. p is drawn on the bar; m is hover-only string pairs.

k.description: Must be s. f is invalid (there is no folder record).

n.description: Stable id. Not shown if p.title is set. Unique among spans is recommended (443-1).

s.description: Inclusive start, file-relative ns. A stint in lap 3 uses that lap's start_ns.

e.description: Exclusive end, file-relative ns. Must be > s.

m.description: Hover-only fields, max 16. Each ["Name","value"] both strings.

laps.title: MTJ laps line
laps.description: Line 2 of an MTJ recording. MTX has no laps line. Empty recording writes []. Laps in non-decreasing start_ns order.

srcp.description: Path of the original recording as seen at first conversion. Carried through rewrites like src.

appliedPass.description: Provenance of one applied processing pass: registry name, version, params, input and output channel names.

videoOffsetNs.description: Recording-level telemetry→player presentation shift in nanoseconds (player_ns = t + vo). Signed; MP4 edit lists make it per-file and non-zero.

videoFileRef.description: One linked video file: basename, 1-based index, frame count, BLAKE3, per-file presentation offset ns.
